response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ci.location AS city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitId = ci.circuitId GROUP BY ci.location), s AS (SELECT city, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.city, s.cnt AS qualifying_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS above_average FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY s.share DESC
